title: Scout Runtime Knowledge Package
description: Defines the structured, task-specific and traceable knowledge assembled by the Scout Retrieval Engine. A Knowledge Package supplies the verified context required by downstream Reasoning and Planning components.

knowledge_package_status.title: Knowledge Package Status
knowledge_package_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the Knowledge Package.

retrieval_mode.title: Retrieval Mode
retrieval_mode.description: Primary method used to obtain knowledge for the package.

retrieval_strategy.title: Retrieval Strategy
retrieval_strategy.description: Execution strategy used by the Retrieval Engine.

knowledge_requirement_type.title: Knowledge Requirement Type
knowledge_requirement_type.description: Category of knowledge required by the Task.

requirement_status.title: Knowledge Requirement Status
requirement_status.description: Current satisfaction state of a knowledge requirement.

knowledge_requirement.title: Knowledge Requirement
knowledge_requirement.description: A specific knowledge need derived from the Task.

retrieval_query.title: Retrieval Query
retrieval_query.description: A query or retrieval action executed to satisfy one or more knowledge requirements.

source_freshness.title: Source Freshness
source_freshness.description: Assessment of whether a source is current enough for the Task.

retrieved_source.title: Retrieved Source
retrieved_source.description: A source retrieved and assessed for potential inclusion in the Knowledge Package.

knowledge_item_type.title: Knowledge Item Type
knowledge_item_type.description: Functional category of a structured knowledge item.

knowledge_item.title: Knowledge Item
knowledge_item.description: A task-relevant unit of knowledge extracted or derived from one or more included sources.

gap_type.title: Knowledge Gap Type
gap_type.description: Category of missing or insufficient knowledge.

knowledge_gap.title: Knowledge Gap
knowledge_gap.description: A missing, unavailable or insufficient area of knowledge relevant to the Task.

conflict_type.title: Knowledge Conflict Type
conflict_type.description: Category of contradiction between sources or knowledge items.

knowledge_conflict.title: Knowledge Conflict
knowledge_conflict.description: An explicit contradiction or incompatibility identified during retrieval.

coverage_assessment.title: Coverage Assessment
coverage_assessment.description: Summary of how completely the Knowledge Package satisfies Task requirements.

retrieval_summary.title: Retrieval Summary
retrieval_summary.description: Operational summary of the retrieval work performed.

id.title: Knowledge Package Identifier
id.description: Unique and immutable identifier of the Knowledge Package.

parent_id.description: Identifier of an earlier Knowledge Package from which this package was revised or extended.

purpose.title: Knowledge Package Purpose
purpose.description: Explains which Task decision or execution need this package is intended to support.

task_objective_snapshot.title: Task Objective Snapshot
task_objective_snapshot.description: Immutable snapshot of the relevant Task objective at retrieval time.

requirements.title: Knowledge Requirements
requirements.description: Knowledge needs derived from the Task and assessed by the Retrieval Engine.

retrieval_queries.title: Retrieval Queries
retrieval_queries.description: Queries and retrieval actions executed while assembling the package.

retrieved_sources.title: Retrieved Sources
retrieved_sources.description: All sources considered by the Retrieval Engine, including excluded sources.

knowledge_items.title: Knowledge Items
knowledge_items.description: Structured and task-relevant knowledge extracted from included sources.

gaps.title: Knowledge Gaps
gaps.description: Missing or insufficient knowledge identified during retrieval.

conflicts.title: Knowledge Conflicts
conflicts.description: Contradictions identified between sources or knowledge items.

examples.title: Knowledge Package for the Next Xiaohongshu Content Package
examples.purpose: Provide authoritative product, brand, content-history and content-standard knowledge required to select and create a new Xiaohongshu content package.
examples.task_objective_snapshot: Create one complete and quality-verified Xiaohongshu Content Package that extends the approved BUXA content strategy without repeating previously covered themes.

requirements.description: Identify themes already covered by approved Xiaohongshu content.
Retrieve approved product knowledge needed to support product-related claims.
Retrieve current approved Xiaohongshu Content Standards.
requirements.purpose: Guide content production and quality review.
